featured_reviews.name: Veikho Asanii
featured_reviews.review_text:
I happened to drop into Amar Juice Centre in Phoenix Mall, Kurla. It was a great deal!
I had chole bhature and masala chai. The chole was one of the best I’ve had so far — soft, flavorful, and perfectly spiced. The bhature was puffy, crispy, and absolutely delicious. The masala chai was slightly on the higher side price-wise, but it was still worth it because the taste was excellent.
The outlet is neat and clean, the staff were polite and professional, and it’s very family-friendly. Whether you’re alone or in a group, it’s easy to get seated and served.
I was especially impressed by the warm water with lemon served after the meal to wash hands — that thoughtful touch was really commendable.
There’s a wide variety of dishes on the menu, so I’ll definitely be coming back to try more items.
Overall, it was a wonderful experience. Highly recommended for a quick, satisfying bite. You won’t regret it!

featured_reviews.review_text: Stopped by Amar Juice Center in phoenix market City Kurla for a massive takeaway haul and it did not disappoint! The Tawa Pulao had that signature street-style spice kick that hits the spot every time. To top it all off, the Mango Milkshake was thick, fresh, and the perfect seasonal treat. Highly recommend for a satisfying late-night craving!"

featured_reviews.name: Ayushi Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amar at Phoenix is a must-visit! 🌟

My boyfriend and I had an incredible experience at the newly opened Amar in Phoenix Mall. Even as a new outlet, they’ve stayed perfectly true to the iconic taste the brand is known for.
It’s a comparatively new spot, but the food is just as legendary as ever. We loved the Jain Manchow Soup, Pav Bhaji and the Schezwan Fried Rice—the perfect blend of spice and comfort. Great service, budget-friendly, and honestly, the look on our faces shows exactly how much we enjoyed it. Highly recommended! 🍜✨

featured_reviews.name: Manish
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ah, Amar Juice Centre at Phoenix Mall—a place where the juiciest gossip isn't just in your group chat but also in your glass! 🍹 This spot has quickly become my go-to oasis in the middle of my retail therapy sessions. 🛍️ You know that moment when you're debating whether you really need another pair of shoes 👠 or if your soul is just thirsty? Amar Juice Centre answers that existential question with a resounding "Yes, you do!"—and then hands you a fresh, cold juice to make you feel good about it. 🥤

The first thing you notice is the sheer variety of juices. 🍇🍊🍍 It’s like walking into a fruit bazaar, but without the haggling and way more style. They’ve got everything from the classic orange juice 🍊 that’ll take you right back to those innocent childhood days, to exotic mixes that make you feel like you’ve just booked a one-way ticket to a tropical paradise. 🌴 And the taste? Let’s just say, even the oranges are proud of how they turned out here. 😋

Now, let’s talk about the ambiance. 🏙️ Nestled within the buzz of Phoenix Mall, Amar Juice Centre is that rare find—a calm, refreshing pit stop in the middle of a retail jungle. 🛒 It's the perfect place to sip on something fresh while you mentally prepare for Round 2 with the sales rack. 🏷️ If malls were sports arenas, Amar Juice Centre would be the halftime show everyone looks forward to. 🎉 The seating is minimal, sure, but you don't need a throne when your drink is royal. 👑

The service? Swift enough to make you wonder if they have a time-turner in the back. ⏰ The staff is as cool as the beverages they serve, which is saying something because, let’s face it, they’re dealing with thirsty, potentially hangry, and most definitely tired mall-goers all day long. 😅 Yet, they do it with a smile that’s almost as refreshing as the juice itself. 😊

And for those of you who think a juice center is too healthy, fear not! 😈 Amar Juice Centre has something for everyone. 🍔 Their sandwiches are so delicious that you’ll forgive them for not being diet-friendly. 🥪 They’ve got a way of turning simple, humble bread into a love letter for your taste buds. ❤️ The frankies are also a must-try, proving that wraps aren't just for birthdays—they’re for lunch, dinner, and any time in between. 🌯

So, if you find yourself at Phoenix Mall, wondering what will quench your thirst for both adventure and refreshment, look no further. 🔍 Amar Juice Centre is more than just a juice bar; it’s a juicy chapter in your mall escapade, with a side of fries (and maybe a sandwich or two). 🍟 Your taste buds will thank you, your shopping bags will have a moment to rest, and you’ll walk away with a story as fresh as the juice in your hand. Cheers to that! 🥂

While my haircut and blow dry were still in progress, the receptionist repeatedly asked for payment and even stopped my husband outside regarding the bill before the service was completed. At that moment, it felt quite disrespectful and judgmental, especially because customers should not be made to feel distrusted during an ongoing service. However, after posting my concern, the salon management reached out to me personally and apologized for the incident, which I genuinely appreciate. It takes professionalism to acknowledge a mistake and address a customer’s concern.

I would also like to mention that hairdresser Sandeep was very polite and kind throughout the appointment.

I hope the staff becomes more mindful about how they approach customers in the future, because communication and basic courtesy make a huge difference in the overall experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am now ammending my below 1 star review to a 5 star. Never expected the salon to call me up and check with me as to what went wrong that day And try to rectify it. This shows exemplary customer service on their behalf. Whoever is sitting in your management team there, kudos to them and Well done !

Earlier review-
The haircut was very good and the stylist was also great. It was my second time there.
But am giving this place 1 star purely because of a specific grievance with the receptionist.
The cost of my haircut was 892 inr I gave her 1000 and a 2 (coin) inr she insisted she doesn't have any change and to make the payment via upi however at the time my upi wasn't available. So she tried to check for the cash (in a very half hearted manner) after a good 5 mins of literally nothing happening i checked my other wallet to see if I had any change luckily I had 2 notes of 200 rs each. So I handed it over to her.
To which she gave me back one 500 inr note. So now I had given her 902 rs and i told her you owe me 10 rs
She just conveniently pretended like she never even heard me I waited for a couple of mins but I realised she was simply not interested the reaction on her face was such that 10 rs is some kind of a donation to the salon or that I shouldn't be asking that to her or that she is not entitled to give that  money back to me since it's a small amount.
No matter what whether it is 1 rs or 100 rs if I am owed money back by the business they have to return that money to me the same way to business is also owed money by its patron.
Even if they don't have that change she could have politely told me "Sir we don't have change right now, is it ok with you ?" I would have happily understood. But the lack of courtesy and etiquette and the entitlement that was in her was so unbecoming of the establishment as a whole.
So yes this was my bad experience there today after a great haircut.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Stopped by Baba Falooda & Chat Corner at 1AM during my recent Mumbai trip and the place was still packed, which already says a lot.
We ordered the Baba Special Falooda. Service was surprisingly quick even with the crowd and that too in the late night closing hours. For ₹300 we got two faloodas as a one-by-two portions and honestly, even the half portion felt enough for two people. The quantity is more than generous.
What I liked most was the taste. It felt authentic, not overloaded with artificial syrups or fake flavors. Just rich, balanced and satisfying.
It is in a busy area and clearly a well known spot. Definitely worth visiting, especially if you are craving something sweet late at night.

Bombay never fails to impress us! ❤️

Delighted !

Apologies for the enthusiastic start, but I couldn't resist myself—the taste here is just awesome ! Tried their butterscotch, Kanu and mango falooda and it was absolutely delicious and satisfying. It's so rich in flavor, though, that one serving is more than enough to fill you up! Overall the quality and taste is very good deserves at least one try !!!!

featured_reviews.name: Md. Farhan Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing experience at Baba Falooda, easily one of the most iconic dessert spots in Mumbai for falooda lovers.

The falooda here is absolutely indulgent—rich, creamy, and loaded with everything you’d want. From perfectly cooked sev and sabja seeds to generous scoops of kulfi, ice cream, and dry fruits, every bite feels like a complete dessert experience. Their Baba Special and Royal Malai Falooda are must-tries—both are super filling and packed with flavor.

What really stands out is the consistency and legacy. This place has been around for decades and still manages to pull huge crowds every day, which says a lot about its quality and popularity.

The vibe is very typical Mumbai—busy, slightly chaotic, and always buzzing. Don’t expect a fancy seating setup; most people either stand and enjoy or take it away.

👍 What Works:

Extremely rich & authentic falooda taste

Generous portions (one can easily be shared)

Wide variety of flavors and combinations

Quick service despite heavy crowd

👎 What Could Be Better:

Limited or no proper seating

Can get very crowded, especially in evenings

Slightly heavy on the stomach if you’re not used to rich desserts

---

🧠 Final Verdict:

If you love falooda, this place is a must-visit in Mumbai. It’s not about ambience, it’s about pure dessert satisfaction and nostalgia. One visit and you’ll know why it’s so hyped.

featured_reviews.name: Digital Omkar karjekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently tried falooda at Baba Falooda near Kurla and had a decent experience. The quality of the falooda was good, and it was served chilled with a nice mix of ingredients like rose syrup, vermicelli, basil seeds, and ice cream.
The taste was enjoyable and refreshing, especially if you want something sweet after a meal. The portion size was satisfactory and the presentation was neat.
Overall, Baba Falooda is a good place to try falooda in the Kurla area. The taste and quality are nice, and it can be a good option when you are in the mood for a cool dessert.
